fusions.name: Shared Nip
fusions.desc: A lunging strike that deals 4 damage, rising to 1.4 times that at its full reach of 4 tiles. Its damage rises 10% for each ally within 5.5 tiles of you (max 40%).

fusions.name: Gathering Thrash
fusions.desc: Lashes out, dealing 28 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles. When it hits, you and your allies deal 15% more damage for 15 seconds.

fusions.name: Basking Ground
fusions.desc: Restores 14 health to you and every ally within 3.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Warm Reserve
fusions.desc: Your armour rises by 10%, and you regenerate 1 health a second.
